zolas-cafe-auburn.name: Morning on Main
zolas-cafe-auburn.idea: An oversized handwritten masthead and a sculptural oval of real coffee turn the morning ritual into a warm editorial cover.
zolas-cafe-auburn.emotion: An unhurried, confident morning: personal, generous and handmade.
zolas-cafe-auburn.composition: Cream editorial canvas; giant plum script across the top; an oval coffee photograph framed by thin orbital rules, with a narrow room portrait at the right and readable copy at the left. A compact stacked composition on phones.
zolas-cafe-auburn.motion: The wordmark rises as one piece, the coffee aperture opens upward and the room portrait arrives last; all motion settles by 1.9 seconds.

zolas-cafe-auburn.name: Through the Red Door
zolas-cafe-auburn.idea: A life-size photograph of the real red door opens like a curtain beside a dramatic plum invitation.
zolas-cafe-auburn.emotion: The anticipation of discovering a beloved neighborhood place: a quiet invitation with a little theater.
zolas-cafe-auburn.composition: Architectural split composition: expressive cream and gold type on a solid plum wall, the real gold-decal red door as a floor-to-ceiling photograph on the right, fine gold threshold lines. On phones the door becomes an arched window above the invitation.
zolas-cafe-auburn.motion: A single plum curtain retracts off the real door, then the invitation settles into place. The threshold line draws once; the complete scene is still by 2.1 seconds.

zolas-cafe-auburn.name: Stay a Little Longer
zolas-cafe-auburn.idea: A panoramic cafe journal pairs monumental plum typography with a sweeping ribbon of the real room and its people-first coffee ritual.
zolas-cafe-auburn.emotion: Belonging: the generous, art-filled cafe you come for and the comfortable room you stay in.
zolas-cafe-auburn.composition: Wide cream masthead with an enormous left-aligned wordmark and right-aligned invitation; below, a full-width three-panel photographic ribbon of fireplace, coffee and cafe interior. A solid plum action rail closes the hero. On mobile the masthead is stacked above the photographic triptych.
zolas-cafe-auburn.motion: Three photographs unfold upward in sequence, like opening a cafe journal; the large wordmark settles above them. Motion is complete by 1.85 seconds.

el-caporal-maple-valley.name: Ranchero · Golden Plate
el-caporal-maple-valley.idea: The burgundy Ranchero composition returns with a crisp, golden flauta plate in its turquoise dish.
el-caporal-maple-valley.composition: Retains the original Ranchero typography, burgundy field, terracotta sunburst and circular image placement; the rejected chalupa photograph is replaced with the real golden flautas.
el-caporal-maple-valley.motion: The two-part name reveals and the plate settles once, complete by 1.9 seconds.

el-caporal-maple-valley.name: First Bite
el-caporal-maple-valley.idea: An enormous, crisp taco photograph meets a sweeping cream invitation and sign-red edge.
el-caporal-maple-valley.emotion: Immediate appetite, lively flavor and generous portions.
el-caporal-maple-valley.composition: The real food fills the left two-thirds edge-to-edge, with a dramatic diagonal cream field for the invitation at right. On phones, the photograph owns the upper half and the cream diagonal carries the type into the lower half; this is an immersive photograph, not an arch or a poster grid.
el-caporal-maple-valley.motion: The food opens across the page, followed by the angled cream field and a two-step typographic arrival; fully settled by 2.15 seconds.

el-caporal-maple-valley.name: Your Usual Table
el-caporal-maple-valley.idea: The real lantern-lit dining room unfolds beside a warm invitation on a tall restaurant menu.
el-caporal-maple-valley.emotion: The familiar welcome of a family-run room you can settle into.
el-caporal-maple-valley.composition: A panoramic window into the actual dining room sits behind a tall cream invitation offset to the right, with a broad red rail carrying the restaurant name at left. The cream panel layers across the photographic edge, and a restrained terracotta frame ties the two together. Mobile keeps the tall real room on one side and the invitation overlapping its lower edge, so the restaurant remains present around the words.
el-caporal-maple-valley.motion: The dining room uncovers first, the cream invitation slides upward once, and a fine frame completes; fully still by 2.2 seconds.

roundup-bar-grill-graham.name: The Night Opens
roundup-bar-grill-graham.idea: A giant warm wordmark gives way to a wide, vivid view of the real room.
roundup-bar-grill-graham.emotion: Familiar faces, the room coming alive, and the pull of a good night out.
roundup-bar-grill-graham.composition: A dark cinematic masthead, a wide photograph that is free of text, and an amber-lit invitation underneath. This is the room-first concept, unlike the roadside poster or cream photo essay.
roundup-bar-grill-graham.motion: The panorama opens outward from its center as the masthead rises into place; the invitation arrives last. All motion ends at 2.35 seconds.

roundup-bar-grill-graham.name: Off the Highway
roundup-bar-grill-graham.idea: An oversized maroon roadside poster turns the real storefront into a destination.
roundup-bar-grill-graham.emotion: An unmistakable local landmark: familiar, full of character, and worth pulling over for.
roundup-bar-grill-graham.composition: A solid maroon field with monumental stacked ROUND / UP lettering, a tilted cream-framed real exterior and a quietly confident invitation. The bold graphic option; no dark-photo backdrop.
roundup-bar-grill-graham.motion: The two title lines slide in from opposing directions, the exterior print settles down onto the poster, and an amber rule draws across. The complete composition is still after 2.15 seconds.

roundup-bar-grill-graham.name: Where the Night Begins
roundup-bar-grill-graham.idea: The cinematic room of The Night Opens meets the bold maroon roadside character of Off the Highway.
roundup-bar-grill-graham.emotion: The confidence of a familiar landmark, and the warm pull of the night waiting inside.
roundup-bar-grill-graham.composition: A monumental cream-and-amber Roundup masthead on maroon, a wide cream-framed panorama of the actual room, and a strong roadside invitation. It combines the two selected ideas without adding a second competing photo.
roundup-bar-grill-graham.motion: The two parts of the masthead arrive from opposite sides, the room opens from the center and the framed panorama settles gently into place. The invitation completes the arrival at 2.35 seconds; all motion then stops.

kelly-lattes-kent.name: The Scenic Sip
kelly-lattes-kent.idea: A sweeping indigo contour opens onto the real patio cups, turning a drive-thru stop into a small escape.
kelly-lattes-kent.emotion: A bright pause in a busy day, with the familiar comfort of a favorite local stop.
kelly-lattes-kent.composition: A cinematic open-air cup photograph fills the right two-thirds; a deep-indigo curved field carries a bold two-line wordmark and a warm invitation. The photograph opens above an indigo text panel on phones.
kelly-lattes-kent.motion: The curved indigo field and copy settle from the left as the real cup photograph makes one gentle approach, finishing by 1.8 seconds.

kelly-lattes-kent.name: Extra Good · Cream & Coffee
kelly-lattes-kent.idea: The chosen second layout and approved latte photo, on warm cream with coffee-brown accents.
kelly-lattes-kent.emotion: The cheerful pick-me-up of a favorite drink: expressive, lively and a little indulgent.
kelly-lattes-kent.composition: Warm cream canvas, large coffee-brown wordmark, an angled real coffee-and-muffin photograph, bold side typography, fine graphic accents and a deeper cream location strip. Layout and framing are unchanged; on phones a two-line masthead leads into the large diagonal photograph.
kelly-lattes-kent.motion: The masthead arrives first, the coffee-and-muffin print glides in and settles at a slight angle, and side lettering steps into place once; everything stops by 1.9 seconds.

kelly-lattes-kent.name: Take the Good Turn
kelly-lattes-kent.idea: A bold cream-and-indigo direction sign sends a sweeping photographic arrow toward your next favorite coffee stop.
kelly-lattes-kent.emotion: Momentum, friendliness and a quick reward: the stop that fits naturally into your day.
kelly-lattes-kent.composition: Oversized left-aligned slab typography on cream, a wide angular photograph shaped into a forward-pointing ribbon, and an indigo route rail with three towns. Mobile turns into a compact directional poster, retaining the photograph and a clear next action.
kelly-lattes-kent.motion: The wordmark slides in from the left, the photographic arrow sweeps across once, and the route line draws toward the three towns; settled by 1.85 seconds.

homestead-brew-sumner.name: The Cabin Welcome
homestead-brew-sumner.idea: The real cedar stand appears in an architectural roof-shaped frame beside a confident morning invitation.
homestead-brew-sumner.emotion: A familiar little stop that makes an ordinary morning feel cared for.
homestead-brew-sumner.composition: Cream editorial type sits beside one large house-shaped photograph, with a fine roofline and amber threshold. Architectural and place-led, unlike the predawn time composition or isolated coffee still life.
homestead-brew-sumner.motion: A fine roofline is drawn, the real cabin photograph opens upward, then the invitation and directions settle in. The entrance finishes at 2.2 seconds.

homestead-brew-sumner.name: Under One Roof
homestead-brew-sumner.idea: The favorite’s cabin silhouette becomes a broad, centered architectural welcome.
homestead-brew-sumner.emotion: The familiar warmth of a little cedar coffee cabin.
homestead-brew-sumner.composition: Warm cream, amber roofline, symmetrical live type, and a wide gabled photograph of the same real cedar cabin.
homestead-brew-sumner.motion: A roofline draws, the photograph opens upward, and the invitation settles by 2.2 seconds.

homestead-brew-sumner.name: The Cabin Postcard
homestead-brew-sumner.idea: The same warm cabin story becomes a tactile photographic keepsake beside oversized type.
homestead-brew-sumner.emotion: The familiar warmth of a little cedar coffee cabin.
homestead-brew-sumner.composition: An off-axis cream photographic print with fine timber-colored framing balances a large warm invitation; photo first on mobile.
homestead-brew-sumner.motion: The framed cabin print lands once with a slight rotation; the headline and actions arrive, then stillness by 2.2 seconds.

village-coffee-maple-valley.name: Magnolia Morning
village-coffee-maple-valley.idea: The real magnolia canopy becomes the invitation, with a quiet cream nameplate beside it.
village-coffee-maple-valley.emotion: Fresh air, a familiar stop and a slower breath before the day.
village-coffee-maple-valley.composition: An edge-to-edge photograph fills the right three-fifths; oversized rose Tinos lettering lives on a narrow cream column that steps into the image. On phones the full hut sits below the name.
village-coffee-maple-valley.motion: The photo opens like a wide curtain, the two brand lines rise into place, and a fine rose line draws once; settled by 2.2 seconds.

village-coffee-maple-valley.name: Morning Ritual
village-coffee-maple-valley.idea: A real takeaway cup and oversized cream lettering turn the drive-thru into a personal morning ritual.
village-coffee-maple-valley.emotion: Grounded, comforting and ready to go with you.
village-coffee-maple-valley.composition: A dusk-blue canvas carries a large cream letterform block; the tall, whole cup photograph leans across a pink strip on the right. The composition has the weight and warmth of coffee in hand.
village-coffee-maple-valley.motion: The cup print rises and settles at a slight angle, then the two title lines and invitation arrive; settled by 2.15 seconds.

village-coffee-maple-valley.name: The Village V
village-coffee-maple-valley.idea: The actual magnolia photograph fills a monumental V, turning the shop’s own initial into the hero.
village-coffee-maple-valley.emotion: Bright, familiar and proud to be part of the Village.
village-coffee-maple-valley.composition: A giant photographic Tinos V owns the pink canvas. The business name and invitation sit beside it on desktop and along the lower edge on phones, creating an emblem-first composition rather than a photo panel.
village-coffee-maple-valley.motion: The photographic V scales gently into place as its offset edge aligns; the name and invitation lift into the lower corner, complete by 2.2 seconds.

glo-skin-clinic-maple-valley.name: A Moment of Quiet
glo-skin-clinic-maple-valley.idea: A centered invitation and generous arched room portrait make a small retreat within the page.
glo-skin-clinic-maple-valley.emotion: Warmth, calm and the feeling that this appointment has been made for you.
glo-skin-clinic-maple-valley.composition: A symmetrical cream gallery composition: two-line serif invitation above a large central arch, fine gold framing, and a low, spacious booking rail. Unlike the side-by-side Open Room and the split editorial headline of Entirely Yours.
glo-skin-clinic-maple-valley.motion: The arch opens upward, its gold contour follows, and the booking rail arrives last. Fully settled at 2.3 seconds.

glo-skin-clinic-maple-valley.name: The Open Room
glo-skin-clinic-maple-valley.idea: An expansive doorway into the real room meets a quiet, personal invitation.
glo-skin-clinic-maple-valley.emotion: An open welcome, an unhurried pace and the ease of being looked after.
glo-skin-clinic-maple-valley.composition: An oversized room portrait fills the left side, framed as a tall gold-edged doorway. A calm serif invitation and booking sit together on the right. On a phone the doorway comes first, unlike the title-first Moment of Quiet.
glo-skin-clinic-maple-valley.motion: The room is revealed upward into its arch, the photograph eases to rest, and the invitation appears in sequence. Fully settled at 2.2 seconds.

glo-skin-clinic-maple-valley.name: Entirely Yours
glo-skin-clinic-maple-valley.idea: A quiet editorial sentence wraps around a wide, softly sculpted view of the real room.
glo-skin-clinic-maple-valley.emotion: Personal attention and room to breathe.
glo-skin-clinic-maple-valley.composition: A split serif headline sits above and below an expansive room photograph, with opposite softened corners and a fine gold offset frame. Booking closes the editorial line, making a broad horizontal composition rather than another portrait arch.
glo-skin-clinic-maple-valley.motion: The room opens horizontally between the two headline phrases, its fine frame follows, and the booking invitation rises gently. Fully settled at 2.3 seconds.

euphoriq-skin-and-beauty-sumner.name: The Living Wall
euphoriq-skin-and-beauty-sumner.idea: The real neon sign glows within an immersive, edge-to-edge wall of green leaves.
euphoriq-skin-and-beauty-sumner.emotion: A lush, private retreat; the studio identity is the entire first impression.
euphoriq-skin-and-beauty-sumner.composition: Unframed real signage and foliage cover the whole hero, with a restrained invitation along the bottom. On phones, the actual sign photograph is kept wide enough to show the full lettering, and cropped foliage from that same photo extends the green wall below.
euphoriq-skin-and-beauty-sumner.motion: The actual photograph brightens once as the lavender light softly blooms across the foliage; the bottom invitation settles, fully still by 2.35 seconds.

euphoriq-skin-and-beauty-sumner.name: The Green Room
euphoriq-skin-and-beauty-sumner.idea: A deep leafy recess brings the actual neon sign forward beside a softly lit invitation.
euphoriq-skin-and-beauty-sumner.emotion: Quiet intimacy and a very personal welcome.
euphoriq-skin-and-beauty-sumner.composition: A tall inset green wall and the actual neon sign fill the left side, with soft lavender light tracing its edge. A quiet invitation occupies the right on deep foliage, keeping most of the first screen devoted to the real signage and leaves. Mobile stacks the deep green sign recess above a compact cream booking panel.
euphoriq-skin-and-beauty-sumner.motion: The green wall opens vertically, the real neon photograph warms to full brightness, and the invitation arrives once; complete by 2.25 seconds.

euphoriq-skin-and-beauty-sumner.name: Botanical Afterglow
euphoriq-skin-and-beauty-sumner.idea: The actual neon wall becomes a luminous floating feature in a layered botanical room.
euphoriq-skin-and-beauty-sumner.emotion: A memorable boutique retreat with depth, glow and a sense of arrival.
euphoriq-skin-and-beauty-sumner.composition: A wide, crisp photographic sign panel floats across a dimmer full foliage wall with a fine lavender rim and a deep cast shadow. The short invitation sits above the panel; the booking action rests below on a restrained dark glass rail. Mobile retains the complete neon lettering in a large landscape panel surrounded by leaves.
euphoriq-skin-and-beauty-sumner.motion: The dimensional sign panel rises into place with one restrained light bloom, followed by the booking rail; everything settles by 2.4 seconds.

salon-410-buckley.name: The Mirror Moment
salon-410-buckley.idea: A luminous oak-framed salon mirror reveals a real finished look inside the atmosphere of the actual room.
salon-410-buckley.emotion: That quiet, good moment when the stylist turns the chair and you see yourself again.
salon-410-buckley.composition: A sculptural arched mirror, three fine concentric frames and a real hair portrait stand in front of the dimmed reception room; enormous cream and oak lettering gives the scene its focal balance.
salon-410-buckley.motion: The mirror opens from its center, the fine frame traces on, the name rises, and one soft reflection travels over the frame; complete by 2.5 seconds.

salon-410-buckley.name: The Signature Cut
salon-410-buckley.idea: A single clean scissors pass opens a dramatic diagonal cut through the salon name and its real front door.
salon-410-buckley.emotion: Confident, energetic and clear: a fresh cut from a familiar place.
salon-410-buckley.composition: Oversized cream SALON 410 lettering lives on a deep sage sheet cut across a warm oak ground. The actual storefront breaks through the lower diagonal edge, with a spacious booking strip beneath.
salon-410-buckley.motion: A fine cutting line travels once, the scissors close as the sheet opens, the storefront is uncovered, and the mark settles; the scissors leave by 2.3 seconds.

salon-410-buckley.name: The Color Studio
salon-410-buckley.idea: A dimensional color book opens to an actual Salon 410 result, with warm swatch pages inspired by the room and the hair.
salon-410-buckley.emotion: Creative hands, considered color, and the excitement of choosing a fresh look.
salon-410-buckley.composition: A large open sample book floats at a deliberate angle over cream and honey oak. A whole result photograph is its central page, surrounded by fanned sage, oak and cream leaves; bold red name lettering grounds the other side.
salon-410-buckley.motion: The fanned leaves turn open in a short stagger, the result page settles into place, and the salon name wipes in once; settled by 2.6 seconds.
